title: SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18735v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantee

translated_title: SP$^2$ec：面向视觉语言模型的自适应自推测解码
translated_abstract: 推测解码已被证明在加速大语言模型推理方面卓有成效，但对于视觉语言模型而言，输入模态的多样性使得小型训练的草稿模型难以实现持续的高吞吐量。自推测解码通过复用目标模型的部分作为草稿模型，从而保留了视觉语言模型的多模态能力，但其效率取决于能否为每个提示选择合适的草稿配置。我们提出了单峰推测解码，这是一种免训练的赌博算法，能够在生成过程中自适应地调整草稿配置。SP$^2$ec 利用在现有自推测方法（包括 SWIFT、KnapSpec、SpecVLM 以及我们提出的简单 cosSim 方法）中观察到的单峰吞吐量模式。我们的算法设计显式地为每个给定查询最小化一种新的墙钟时间遗憾，该遗憾与经验墙钟时间延迟相对应。理论保证……
tldr: 提出免训练的赌博算法SP$^2$ec，利用自推测解码的单峰吞吐量特性，在生成过程中自适应调整草稿配置并最小化墙钟时间遗憾，从而加速视觉语言模型的推理。
en_tdlr: SP$^2$ec is a training-free bandit algorithm that exploits the single-peak throughput pattern of self-speculative decoding to adaptively adjust draft configurations during generation while minimizing wall-time regret, thereby accelerating Vision-Language Model inference.
